text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-C-04, Vitruvius Brushed Stainless Steel Pull

Acorn has some of the most eye catching designs in cabinet hardware and the Vitruvius Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is no exception. Sometimes modern hardware can seem so cookie-cutter, sleek line blending into sleek line, but the Vitruvius Pull's tapered ends are a pleasant surprise, adding just enough sharpness to liven up a space. It is a perfect finishing touch to any contemporary space.

Also Available Matching Vitruvius Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Vitruvius Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 5-1/2"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
